text:
incident-bot: ALERT P2: sudden quality regression observed for tenant BetaFin on dedicated-pool-7. Metric: answer_coherence_score fell from 0.81 -> 0.39 after quant profile qv3.1 rollout. Alert ref: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/BETA-QREG-2110

lee (oncall): paging @garcia @olga @sam @nina 1: BetaFin reporting severe hallucinations and malformed multi-paragraph responses. Suspect tenant-scoped profile change.

garcia (ml-engineer): pulling rollout metadata and recent samples. Which job applied qv3.1?

ops-bot: profile-rollout: tenant=BetaFin pool=dedicated-pool-7 profile=qv3.1 started_by=deploy-bot at=2026-11-04T11:05:12Z

olga (ml-research): qv3.1 introduced an aggressive per-channel quant step that reduces fallback logits. In bench runs it shaved 6% latency but we had a marginal degradation on long-form contexts. Need real samples.

garcia (ml-engineer): sample from production: 
"User: Draft an investment memo about Q4 expansion plans.
Model: Our strategy will focus on.. the market is expected to grow.
" 1 truncated mid-thought and inserted unrelated company names.

lee (oncall): confirm isolation: does this affect any other tenants on the pool?

olga (ml-research): profile mapping shows only BetaFin mapped to qv3.1. Pool runs same binary but kernel path differs by profile flags. tenant-scoped caches in place. looks isolated.

sam (sre): infra check: dedicated-pool-7 GPUs 72% util, no ECC errors, no preemption. Not an infra crash.

nina (customer-success): BetaFin escalation: they flagged regulatory-sensitive outputs being hallucinated. They're requesting immediate rollback and technical note.

lee (oncall): action plan propose: staged rollback to qv3.0 for BetaFin with canary -> 30% -> 100%. Owners? garcia for rollout, olga for regression test, sam for infra monitoring, nina for customer comms. Aim: start within 12m.

garcia (ml-engineer): I will run the rollback. commands: 
```
rctl profiles get --tenant BetaFin --pool dedicated-pool-7
rctl profiles set --tenant BetaFin --pool dedicated-pool-7 --profile qv3.0 --apply --rollout-strategy canary --canary-percent 10
```

lee (oncall): ensure routing policy keeps fallback to qv3.0 if any errors. I'll coordinate with nina to message BetaFin.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued id=rb-2110 triggered_by=garcia at=2026-11-04T11:16:40Z

garcia (ml-engineer): applying canary 10% now. sampling outputs and coherence metric.

ops-bot: profile-change: tenant=BetaFin pool=dedicated-pool-7 target_profile=qv3.0 rollout=canary(10%) job_id=rb-2110

garcia (ml-engineer): initial canary cohort score: answer_coherence_score=0.72 (+0.33 vs impacted). latency +1ms. no kernel errors in canary logs.

olga (ml-research): good sign. let's expand to 30% after 6m if stable. adding BetaFins sensitive prompt set to the canary evaluation to ensure long-form behavior improves.

sam (sre): monitoring dashboards up: /dash/tenant/BetaFin/quality & /dash/pool/dedicated-pool-7. watching kernel warnings and allocator metrics.

nina (customer-success): BetaFin PM updated: we're doing a staged rollback; you'll see improvement for a subset of requests shortly. asked for confirmation when at 100%.

garcia (ml-engineer): bumping canary to 30% now.

ops-bot: canary bump scheduled by job rb-2110 to 30% at 2026-11-04T11:25:00Z

garcia (ml-engineer): canary at 30%: cohort score 0.73. full-pool still low (0.39) until we finish rollout.

lee (oncall): I'm starting handoff now; I'll be available by DMs. sam will be primary oncall after handoff. sam ACK?

sam (sre): ACK. monitoring active.

olga (ml-research): samples from canary show restored coherence. also found qv3.1 unit test gap: missing long-context repetition test. I'll add.

garcia (ml-engineer): proceeding to 100% rollout now:
```
rctl profiles set --tenant BetaFin --pool dedicated-pool-7 --profile qv3.0 --apply --rollout-strategy immediate
```

deploy-bot: profile-change completed tenant=BetaFin pool=dedicated-pool-7 profile=qv3.0 job_id=rb-2110 status=success at=2026-11-04T11:33:12Z

olga (ml-research): post-rollback metrics: answer_coherence_score=0.78 (near pre-rollout 0.81). minor latency unchanged. sampled outputs show no hallucination on tested prompts.

garcia (ml-engineer): smoke tests pass. example good output: 
"The memo should include market sizing, risk factors, and projected cash flows..." full paragraph present.

nina (customer-success): BetaFin confirms visible improvements on their staging. They're requesting a brief post-mortem and preventive measures.

lee (oncall): quick RCA: root cause: qv3.1s aggressive quant step altered fallback/logit clamping behavior in kernel; uncovered by BetaFin's long-form, regulatory prompts and their dedicated kernel specialization. Immediate mitigation: tenant-scoped rollback. Longer term actions:
- olga: add BetaFin-sensitive prompts to regression suite and ensure long-context tests (owner: olga)
- garcia: implement auto-rollback trigger if answer_coherence_score drops >0.2 within 20m after rollout (owner: garcia)
- sam: mark dedicated-pool-7 in release checklist for per-pool profiling notes (owner: sam)
- nina: schedule customer PM post-mortem and provide technical write-up (owner: nina)

sam (sre): filing infra ticket to annotate kernel flags and add alerts for kernel-path anomalies. linking thread.

deploy-bot: incident ticket updated: INC-BETA-QREG-2110 status=mitigated

lee (oncall): keeping incident open for 2h monitoring. if no regressions, will close. thanks all for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Monitoring set: watch window 2h for tenant=BetaFin metric=answer_coherence_score threshold=0.2

garcia (ml-engineer): will follow up with a patch to the rollout tool to require sensitive-prompt checks when profiles change kernel flags.

olga (ml-research): will push new regression tests to canary harness tomorrow AM.

nina (customer-success): BetaFin asked for weekly check-ins for next week. I'll coordinate.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for tenant=BetaFin at 2026-11-04T13:30:00Z. No further paging for this alert class for 24h.

sam (sre): closing from infra side.

lee (oncall): closing thread.
